target_year_over_year_context.explanation: Both disclosures focus on the accrued liabilities and severance payments associated with the 2024 Restructuring Plan. The 2025 disclosure (D126) reports the subsequent severance payments made in 2024 ($24M) and 2025 ($79M), and the reduced liability of $10 million as of Dec 27, 2025. These are complementary aspects of the same specific financial tracking of the restructuring plan's liabilities.

comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclose that restructuring charges are included in their unallocated or 'All Other' corporate segment categories rather than specific operating segments. AMD specifies that $89 million in accrued restructuring charges are recorded in Accrued liabilities and included in the All Other category (Sentences: amd_2024_8_P128_S003, amd_2024_8_P128_S006). Similarly, Broadcom identifies restructuring and other charges as a component of unallocated expenses that are not used in evaluating segment results (Sentence: avgo_2024_8_P190_S001).

sentences.text: Restructuring charges are included within the All Other category presented in Note 4 - Segment Reporting.
As of December 28, 2024, $89 million of accrued restructuring charges are recorded within Accrued liabilities of the Company's Consolidated Balance Sheets.

Unallocated expenses include amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets, stock-based compensation expense, restructuring and other charges, acquisition-related costs, and other costs, which are not used in evaluating the results of, or in allocating resources to, our segments.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company incurred $442 million in other non-cash asset impairment charges as a direct result of the 2024 Restructuring Plan, included in corporate unallocated expenses within the restructuring and other category.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Intel disclose specific accounting treatments for restructuring-related charges within their unallocated or corporate expense categories. AMD records $89 million in accrued restructuring charges within Accrued liabilities and includes these charges in the All Other segment category (Sentences: amd_2024_8_P128_S003, amd_2024_8_P128_S006). Intel incurred $442 million in other non-cash asset impairment charges as a direct result of its 2024 Restructuring Plan, which were included as a component of 'corporate unallocated expenses' (Sentences: intc_2024_8_P107_S001, intc_2024_8_P107_S002). Both companies treat these restructuring costs as non-operating or unallocated items distinct from core segment performance.

sentences.text: Restructuring charges are included within the All Other category presented in Note 4 - Segment Reporting.
As of December 28, 2024, $89 million of accrued restructuring charges are recorded within Accrued liabilities of the Company's Consolidated Balance Sheets.

We also incurred certain other non-cash asset impairment charges of $442 million as a direct result of the 2024 Restructuring Plan (see "Note 7: Restructuring and Other Charges" within Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements).

These charges were included as a component of "corporate unallocated expenses" within the restructuring and other category presented in "Note 3: Operating Segments" within Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements.
